# Codex Token Bar v0.9.11
## 简体中文
修复部分用户覆盖安装 0.9.10 后仍停留在“账本准备未完成”的问题，Mac 与 Windows 同步更新。
- 修复每日维护时钟正常推进、额度观察继续追加后，未完成迁移被误判为旧账改写的问题；旧观察和账户归属仍完整核验。 - 完善 Exact 索引接续：区分运行元数据与历史消费，验证已知解析修复与原文关联；已发布的历史用量保留，原文不可用的关联仍保持不可用，不合并重复副本、不重复计账。 - 加强恢复目标保护：现有分区若出现冻结快照之外的记录，拒绝覆盖；真正替换前会在写入事务内再次核对。 - 保留原始会话、旧账、迁移备份和中断恢复证据；金额改写、归属冲突、已知指纹矛盾或无法证明的变化继续安全拒绝。 - 兼容Windows较长数据目录中的测速恢复备份，旧回执和来源标识保持不变。 - 补充组合故障、启动、中断恢复和重复启动的双端回归。 - 修复侧栏三级菜单在汇总范围丢失24小时Codex额度曲线的问题；稀疏额度采样也能显示，不伪造缺失窗口。
遇到旧版启动提示的用户可直接覆盖更新，无需先卸载或删除数据目录。请保留旧数据库与迁移清单。
## English
Fix startup blocks that still affected some users after installing 0.9.10. Mac and Windows are updated together.
- Allow unfinished quota migrations to resume after normal maintenance-clock advancement and appended observations, while verifying all historical observations and account ownership. - Improve Exact index continuity by separating operational state from historical consumption and verifying known parser repairs and raw bindings. Preserve already-published historical usage while keeping unavailable raw links unavailable. Duplicate copies are not summed or counted twice. - Protect recovery destinations: refuse replacement when a partition contains changes outside its frozen snapshots, and recheck its proof inside the write transaction before replacement. - Preserve original sessions, accounting history, migration backups, and recovery evidence. Changed historical amounts, ownership conflicts, conflicting known fingerprints, and unproved transitions remain safely rejected. - Support completed-body recovery backups in longer Windows data directories while preserving existing receipts and source identities. - Add cross-platform regression coverage for the combined incident, startup, interruption recovery, and repeated startup. - Restore the sidebar detail's 24-hour Codex quota trend in aggregate scope. Sparse observations remain visible without inventing missing quota windows.
Install over the existing version without uninstalling or deleting data directories. Keep old databases and migration receipts.

# Codex Token Bar v0.9.10
## 简体中文
本次合并升级恢复与压缩用量计账修复，Mac 和 Windows 同步更新。
- 修复部分 0.9.8／0.9.9 用户被正常保留的旧索引副本拦截、无法进入应用的问题，兼容旧版 schema 13 与 14 的接续。 - 保护运行中新建的数据分区，避免晚到旧库将其误判为空并覆盖；完善迁移中断、旧文件或目录被移走后的备份恢复；已接收的旧库不再反复作为活动来源打开。无法安全核验的来源会保留并提示，不通过清空账本绕过。 - 相同输入重试复用已验证的迁移备份，修复重复制造副本；现有旧账、备份和恢复材料继续保留。 - 正确计入可确认的 Codex 压缩请求用量，排除累计快照、继承计数和重复镜像；费用、缓存统计、图表及周期归因同步修正。 - 未报告用量保持为未知；存在缺口的区间保留已知费用小计，避免输出不可靠的整期额度反推或本机／非本机消耗结论。 - 可读取的历史由后台回算；原始会话已删除时仍保留已入账历史，不猜补缺失用量。测速和排行榜上报口径保持独立。
如果旧版提示“账本准备未完成”，请直接覆盖安装 0.9.10。无需先卸载，也不要删除数据目录、旧数据库或迁移清单。
macOS 为 Apple Silicon、ad-hoc 签名且未公证；Windows 提供 x64 和 ARM64 安装包，无商业代码签名。自动更新继续使用原有 Sparkle 与 Tauri 更新签名。
## English
This release combines upgrade recovery and compaction-usage accounting fixes for Mac and Windows.
- Fix startup blocks affecting some 0.9.8/0.9.9 users when valid retained index copies coexist, including the schema 13-to-14 upgrade path. - Protect namespaces created by running modules from being mistaken for empty import destinations. Improve interrupted migration and verified-backup recovery after old files or directories move. Consumed originals are no longer reopened as active inputs. Sources that cannot be safely verified are preserved with a diagnostic rather than bypassed by clearing history. - Reuse verified migration backups for unchanged retries instead of generating duplicate copies. Existing accounting history, backups, and recovery evidence remain preserved. - Account for confirmed Codex compaction requests while excluding cumulative snapshots, inherited counters, and duplicate mirrors. Update costs, cache statistics, charts, and cycle attribution consistently. - Keep unreported usage unknown. Intervals with gaps retain known cost subtotals without unreliable full-cycle quota estimates or definitive local-versus-other-device attribution. - Reprocess readable history in the background. Keep recorded history when original sessions are missing, without inventing usage. Speed measurements and leaderboard reporting retain their separate accounting rules.
If an older version reports “Ledger preparation incomplete,” install 0.9.10 over it. Do not uninstall first or delete data directories, old databases, or migration receipts.
The Apple Silicon Mac package is ad-hoc signed and not notarized. Windows x64 and ARM64 installers have no commercial code-signing certificate. Automatic updates retain the existing Sparkle and Tauri signatures.

# Codex Token Bar v0.9.9
## 简体中文
本次为升级兼容性修复，重点解决部分 Windows 用户更新后无法进入应用的问题。
- 修复把旧版本正常保留的迁移清单误判为未完成迁移，导致出现“账本准备未完成”的启动拦截。 - 自动核验并接续可信旧账本，兼容升级中断、已有部分新库，以及之后再接入旧数据目录的情况。 - 保留原始数据库、回滚库和迁移材料；候选库不作为已提交账目导入。真正缺库、损坏或未知格式仍会保护性停止并提示。 - 修复账本内部复制的外键顺序问题及 Windows 首次创建目录时的索引路径识别问题。
如果 0.9.8 已无法进入应用，请下载对应的 Windows 安装包直接覆盖安装 0.9.9。无需先卸载，也不要删除数据目录、迁移清单或旧数据库。
Mac 与 Windows 同步更新。macOS 包为 Apple Silicon、ad-hoc 签名且未公证；Windows 提供 x64 和 ARM64 安装包，无商业代码签名。自动更新继续使用原有 Sparkle 与 Tauri 更新签名。
## English
This compatibility patch fixes a startup failure affecting some Windows users after upgrading.
- Fix a false “Ledger preparation incomplete” startup block caused by migration receipts intentionally retained by earlier versions. - Validate and resume trusted legacy ledgers, including interrupted upgrades, partially initialized new containers, and legacy data directories added later. - Preserve original databases, rollback databases, and migration evidence. Never import uncommitted candidate data as recorded usage. Missing, corrupt, or unknown-format sources still stop safely with a diagnostic. - Fix foreign-key ordering during internal ledger copies and Windows index-path identity when directories are first created.
If version 0.9.8 cannot open, download the matching Windows installer and install 0.9.9 over the existing installation. Do not uninstall first or delete the data directory, migration receipts, or old databases.
Both Mac and Windows are updated. The Apple Silicon Mac package is ad-hoc signed and not notarized. Windows x64 and ARM64 installers have no commercial code-signing certificate. Automatic updates retain the existing Sparkle and Tauri update signatures.

# Codex Token Bar v0.9.8
## 简体中文
本次更新加入多客户端本地用量统计，并重点修复升级兼容、历史账本保留和图表计价。
- 支持在 Codex、Claude CLI、Claude Desktop 与汇总范围之间切换；其他已支持客户端可按需启用。Claude 仅读取本地记录和已有额度缓存，不向 Anthropic 发起请求。 - 保留 Codex 历史账本，新增客户端及测速数据独立存储。升级前保留备份；归档、删除或移动原始会话文件不会删除已经记录的历史用量。 - 修复选区包含最后一个空时间格时金额突然跳涨的问题，使气泡、固定选区与明细使用同一份模型和用量快照。 - 新增正文 TPS 明细与速度分布；活动速率曲线保留原始采样点。改进模型配色、侧栏设置、多屏拖动吸附和展开收起效果。 - 提供可随时关闭、默认关闭的速蹬排行榜上报；只上报允许的统计字段，不上传对话内容或账号凭据。Claude 来源不参与上报。改善临时失败后的自动重试及 WebSocket 消息兼容。 - 同步修复 Codex 分页子 Agent 继承记录重复计算、Claude Desktop 工具结束后继续估速，以及 Mac 跨夜恢复会话后未及时读取的问题。 - 减少首页重复费用计算和数据库连接开销，增强旧版本升级、中断恢复、锁冲突和未知数据库版本的保护。
额度查询需要本机已安装并登录 Codex；Claude 额度仅在本地有有效缓存时显示。macOS 14 起，Mac 包支持 Apple Silicon；Windows 提供 x64 和 ARM64。Mac 应用为 ad-hoc 签名、未公证；Windows 安装包无商业代码签名。自动更新分别验证 Sparkle 与 Tauri 更新签名。
## English
This update adds local multi-client usage statistics and focuses on upgrade compatibility, historical ledger retention, and chart pricing.
- Switch between Codex, Claude CLI, Claude Desktop, and an aggregate view. Other supported clients can be enabled as needed. Claude reads only local records and existing quota caches; it makes no requests to Anthropic. - Retain the Codex ledger while storing additional clients and speed measurements separately. Preserve upgrade backups and recorded usage when original sessions are archived, deleted, or moved. - Fix the sudden cost increase when a selection includes the final empty chart bucket. Tooltips, pinned selections, and details use the same model and usage snapshot. - Add body-TPS details and speed distributions while retaining raw activity-rate samples. Improve model colors, sidebar settings, multi-monitor dragging and docking, and expansion transitions. - Offer optional leaderboard reporting, disabled by default and switchable at any time. Only permitted statistics are uploaded, never conversations or account credentials. Claude sources are excluded. Improve transient retries and WebSocket message compatibility. - Fix inherited-prefix accounting for paginated Codex subagents, lingering Claude Desktop estimates after tool-ended runs, and missed macOS updates when quiet sessions resume after midnight. - Reduce repeated homepage cost calculations and database connection overhead. Strengthen legacy upgrades, interrupted recovery, lock-contention handling, and unknown-version safeguards.
Codex quota queries require a locally installed, signed-in Codex. Claude quota appears only when a valid local cache is available. Requires macOS 14 or newer; the Mac package is for Apple Silicon. Windows x64 and ARM64 packages are provided. The Mac app is ad-hoc signed and not notarized; Windows installers have no commercial code-signing certificate. Automatic updates verify their respective Sparkle and Tauri update signatures.

# Codex Token Bar v0.9.7
## 简体中文
- 额度和重置卡改由本机 Codex 官方接口查询，复用一个后台子进程，减少反复初始化。额度与卡片共享查询结果，并处理超时、断线重连和退出清理。 - 恢复可关闭的低缓存命中提醒：按实际返回的输入与缓存 token 判断，提示可能由模型、思考强度或上下文变化造成的低命中。 - 续问时限建议、缓存间隔图及其额外扫描仍停用。缓存命中统计、费用账本和已有历史数据保留。 - 保留 v0.9.6 的 Windows 自定义启动入口保护与 RadarBench v6 兼容修复；适配新版 macOS Codex 的内置 CLI 目录。
额度查询需要本机已安装并登录 Codex。macOS 最低 14，当前 Mac 包为 Apple Silicon；Windows 提供 x64 和 ARM64。macOS 为 ad-hoc 签名、未公证，Windows 安装包没有商业代码签名；自动更新使用各自的更新签名验证。
## English
- Query quota and earned reset cards through the local official Codex interface. Reuse one background child process, share the returned snapshot, and handle timeouts, reconnects and owned-process cleanup. - Restore optional low-cache-hit reminders based on reported input and cached tokens, with model, reasoning-effort and context changes explained as possible causes. - Follow-up timing recommendations, cache interval charts and their extra scanner remain disabled. Cache accounting, the cost ledger and existing history are retained. - Keep the Windows custom-launcher protection and RadarBench v6 fixes from v0.9.6, and recognize the current macOS bundled Codex CLI location.
Quota queries require a locally installed and signed-in Codex. macOS 14 or newer is required; the Mac package is for Apple Silicon. Windows x64 and ARM64 packages are included. The Mac app is ad-hoc signed and not notarized; Windows installers do not have a commercial code-signing certificate. Both automatic-update lanes verify their respective update signatures.
